payload.title: Tracing Transformations
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to track data transformations using the `keep_log` parameter in the Pyleoclim library. It focuses on ensuring reproducibility by logging each step of data manipulation, using a dataset of benthic δ18O records. The notebook includes loading the dataset, slicing, detrending, interpolating, and standardizing the data, while maintaining a log of these transformations. The final output is a visual representation of the data transformations applied.
